sentences.text: Mr. Shakti Raj Sinha, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Vivek Sharma, Additional Advocate General for the State.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner is prosecuting for the offence under Sections 420, 419, 409, 467, 468, 471 of IPC and Section 7 of Essential Commodities Act, 1955 and Section 13(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, and the charges have been framed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Rajpur, District Balrampur-Ramanujganj, whereas the learned Judicial Magistrate has no jurisdiction to try the offences under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
Learned counsel for the State would draw attention of this Court in Para 10 of the impugned order dated Digitally signed by 06.02.2025, which is annexed as Annexure P-1 i.e. the VEDPRAKASH VEDPRAKASH DEWANGAN order passed by Revisional Court, in which it has been DEWANGAN Date:
2025.04.11 19:21:38 +0530 mentioned that after framing of charge an application under Section 323 of CRPC has been filed by the prosecution and in compliance of that the case was transferred to the Court of Special Judge (Prevention of Corruption Act), Balrampur, place Ramanujganj.
Registry is directed to call for a report from the concerned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Rajpur with respect to the case along with the complete order sheets, as to whether the Criminal Case No. 63 of 2023 (State v. Mohammad Iqbal) is pending there or the same has been transferred/committed to the Special Court under the Prevention of Corruption Act.
List this case on 21st of April, 2025.
Sd/-
